description: This file defines the Authorities interface, which specifies methods for checking authorization permissions and retrieving authority claims related to resources and operations within the org.eclipse.hono.auth package.

classes.name: Authorities
classes.description: An interface that provides methods to determine if specific actions on resources are authorized and to retrieve authority claims as a map.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the authorities include claims allowing an intended activity on a resource, given a ResourceIdentifier and an Activity.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the authorities include claims allowing execution of an operation of a resource, given a ResourceIdentifier and an operation string.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns the authorities as a map of claims.
